result.instructions: Tools for Hello Club, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which members have an unpaid balance, and how much do they owe in total?"; "Whose membership ends in the next week?"; "Show next week's classes that still have spaces left.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hello Club data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hello_club_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hello_club_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hello_club_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hello_club_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hello_club_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List or search the club's members (people and staff) with contact details, roles, memberships (subscriptions), account credit and amount owing. Filter by free text, gender, role, staff, money owing, account credit, current subscription state, ending subscriptions or a membership type. GET /member.

is_staff.description: Only staff members (true) or only non-staff (false).

has_money_owing.description: Only members with unpaid transactions (true) or without (false).

has_account_credit.description: Only members with account credit (true) or without (false).

with_current_subscription.description: Only members with a current membership subscription.

without_current_subscription.description: Only members without a current membership subscription.

subscription_ending.description: Members whose subscription ends within the next hour/day/week/month/year.

subscription_ended.description: Members whose subscription ended within the past hour/day/week/month/year.

membership_id.description: Membership type id (hello_club_list_membership_types), used together with one of the subscription filters.

updated_since.description: Only members updated on or after this timestamp.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Only return these fields of each item (e.g. ["id","firstName","lastName","email"]). Smaller replies are faster.

tools.name: hello_club_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: One member by id: profile, contact details, roles, subscriptions, account credit, amount owing, custom fields. Password hashes and payment-provider data are not returned. GET /member/{id}.

member_id.description: Hello Club member id (24 hex characters) - find it with hello_club_list_members.

tools.name: hello_club_list_membership_types
tools.title: List membership types
tools.description: The membership types (plans) the club sells: name, fee, term, age limits, renewal rules and access. GET /membership.

tools.name: hello_club_get_membership_type
tools.title: Get membership type
tools.description: One membership type by id. GET /membership/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List or search events and classes (sessions, courses, tournaments) with dates, activity, area, organiser, capacity and attendance rules. Filter by date range, recurring, hidden, public, has attendees, has spaces left, rule type, activity, area or organiser. GET /event.

from_date.description: Events from this date on (use together with to_date).

to_date.description: Events up to this date (use together with from_date).

is_recurring.description: Only recurring events (true) or one-off events (false).

is_hidden.description: Only hidden events (true) or visible ones (false).

is_public.description: Only public events (true) or member-only ones (false).

has_attendees.description: Only events with at least one attendee.

has_spaces_left.description: Only events that still have places left.

rule_type.description: Only events with this attendance rule type.

activity_id.description: Only events of this activity id.

area_id.description: Only events in this area id.

organiser_id.description: Only events organised by this member id.

membership_id.description: Only events that can be attended with this membership type id.

category_id.description: Only events in this category id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Only return these fields of each item (e.g. ["id","firstName","lastName","email"]). Smaller replies are faster.

tools.name: hello_club_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event by id: dates, recurrence, activity, area, organiser, capacity, attendance rules, questions. GET /event/{id}.

event_id.description: Event id - find it with hello_club_list_events.

tools.name: hello_club_list_event_attendees
tools.title: List event attendees
tools.description: List who is signed up to events: member or guest, event, sign-up date, paid state, whether they attended. Filter by event, member or guest. GET /eventAttendee.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Only return these fields of each item (e.g. ["id","firstName","lastName","email"]). Smaller replies are faster.

tools.name: hello_club_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings (courts, rooms, lanes): owner, activity, area, start/end, paid state, recurrence. Filter by date range, member, activity, mode, area, recurring, paid or removed. GET /booking.

from_date.description: Bookings from this date on (use together with to_date).

to_date.description: Bookings up to this date (use together with from_date).

member_id.description: Only bookings that include this member.

is_recurring.description: Only recurring bookings (true) or one-off bookings (false).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Only return these fields of each item (e.g. ["id","firstName","lastName","email"]). Smaller replies are faster.

tools.name: hello_club_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List the club's financial transactions (invoices, charges, credits): member, type, amount, tax, due and payment dates, paid state. Filter by member, type, paid, credit or a date range on date / dueDate / paymentDate. GET /transaction.

date_field.description: Which date from_date / to_date apply to (default date).

from_date.description: From this date on (use together with to_date).

to_date.description: Up to this date (use together with from_date).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Only return these fields of each item (e.g. ["id","firstName","lastName","email"]). Smaller replies are faster.

tools.name: hello_club_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: member, type, amount, tax, details, dates, paid state. GET /transaction/{id}.

transaction_id.description: Transaction id - find it with hello_club_list_transactions.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

door.description: Only entries for this door id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: hello_club_create_member
tools.title: Create member
tools.description: WRITE: create a new member in the club (first and last name required; email, mobile, phone and gender optional). Creates a real member record in the club's database; it does not assign a membership or send an invoice. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two members, so search with hello_club_list_members first. POST /member.

tools.name: hello_club_create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: WRITE: create a financial transaction for a member (a charge, or a credit when is_credit is true), e.g. an invoice line or a manual adjustment. This changes the member's amount owing / account credit in the club's books and, with notify_by_email, emails the member. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two transactions. Confirm member, amount and type with the user first. POST /transaction.

type.description: Transaction type (use 'other' for a manual charge).

amount.description: Amount in the club's currency, a positive number (tax inclusive).

is_credit.description: True = a credit to the member instead of a charge (default false).

notify_by_email.description: Email the member about this transaction (default false).
